description: Desired resident services per checkout. `pnpm kyberion scheduler reconcile` diffs this against the units the host service manager actually has (libs/core/daemon/installed-units.ts) and installs checkout-scoped units (com.kyberion.<id>.ws-<hash>). Required services are installed by reconcile --apply; optional services only with --include <id>. A service with owner_surface is run by surface-runtime whenever that surface is enabled, so no OS unit is installed for it then.

services.rationale: The only pipeline scheduler; when it is not running every registered schedule silently stops firing.
Periodic heartbeat check that must fire even when every watched daemon is dead, which a chronos-scheduled pipeline cannot guarantee.
Clients spawn the supervisor on demand and it holds a daemon lock; a resident unit is only useful for always-on agent runtimes.
The generation-schedule surface runs this daemon when enabled; an OS unit as well would double every tick.
